extractedText: Veolia Targets Robust Organic Revenue Growth in 2026 Jacques MeaudrePublished on 02/26/2026 at 03:26 am EST MarketScreener.com - Translated by Marketscreener Legal disclaimerContact us to request a correctionBack - See original Share VEOLIA ENVIRONNEMENT +1.50% WASTE MANAGEMENT, INC. +2.97% Veolia reported revenue of €44,396 million, up +1.4% at constant scope and exchange rates and +2.8% excluding the impact of energy prices. The Water Technologies segment generated revenue of €4,954 million, marking a +3.6% increase at constant scope and exchange rates compared to 2024. The Waste segment posted revenue of €2,853 million, representing a decrease of -3.7% at constant scope and exchange rates. EBITDA stood at €7,050 million versus €6,788 million as of December 31, 2024, reflecting growth of +6.3% at constant scope and exchange rates. The margin improved by +70 basis points. Current net income, Group share, reached €1,643 million as of December 31, 2025, an increase of +9.1%. Current net income, Group share, per share amounted to €2.25 compared to €2.13, up +7.6% at constant exchange rates. Published net income, Group share, came in at €1,217 million versus €1,098 million as of December 31, 2024 (+10.9%). For 2026, the group is targeting robust organic revenue growth excluding energy prices, organic EBITDA growth between +5% and +6%, and current net income, Group share, growth of at least +8% at constant exchange rates and excluding Clean Earth. The group also expects current net income, Group share, per share growth to be in line with current net income, Group share, thanks to its share buyback plan designed to offset the impact of the employee shareholding plan, and dividend growth in line with current net income, Group share, per share. © MarketScreener.com - 2026 Share
